title: Binding Mode Matters: Hotspot-Aware Drug Discovery via Explorative Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2611.14956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discovering hit molecules requires not just high binding affinity, but also the identification of diverse binding modes, which are critical for experimental assays. Existing generative approaches have predominantly relied on optimizing a scalar docking score, obscuring the distinct contributions of key binding determinants. To this end, we introduce a paradigm shift by formulating target-based drug design as a multi-objective exploration task, where each objective explicitly corresponds to enhancing interactions with a specific hotspot. Here, we introduce BindMol, a novel generative framework driven by a customized multi-objective reinforcement learning algorithm. By incorporating explorative preferences during training, our approach efficiently uncovers molecules with diverse and desirable binding profiles. translated_title: 结合模式至关重要：基于探索性偏好的热点感知药物发现
translated_abstract: 发现先导分子不仅需要高结合亲和力，还需要识别多样的结合模式，这对实验测定至关重要。现有的生成式方法主要依赖于优化单一标量对接分数，从而掩盖了关键结合决定因素的独特贡献。为此，我们通过将基于靶标的药物设计重新构建为一个多目标探索任务来实现范式转变，其中每个目标明确对应于增强与特定热点的相互作用。在此，我们提出了BindMol，一个由定制的多目标强化学习算法驱动的新型生成框架。通过在训练过程中引入探索性偏好，我们的方法能够高效地发现具有多样且理想结合特征的分子。实验结果表明，BindMol能够促进发现兼具结构多样性和高亲和力的化合物。
tldr: 该论文提出BindMol生成框架，将基于靶标的药物设计重新定义为多目标探索任务，通过定制多目标强化学习算法并结合探索性偏好，发现具有多样结合模式且能与关键热点相互作用的高亲和力化合物。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BindMol, a generative framework that reformulates target-based drug design as a multi-objective exploration task via customized multi-objective reinforcement learning with explorative preferences, enabling the discovery of high-affinity compounds with diverse binding modes and hotspot interactions.
